With his two roommates, he defies professors and pursues the dean's daughter. Ten years later, his friends search for the missing Rancho, unearthing their absurd yet moving past adventures.

A foul-mouthed white tough guy and a refined musician, they initially clash on the road but ultimately save each other's lives.

The only one who can't lie without vomiting, Harlan's compassionate nurse Marta, becomes an unwitting human lie detector, crucial to solving the case.

When he gets out, he has a child of his own. To pay off his son's debts, Old Chen drives his instructor car in circles around Taipei. Under the sun, there's nowhere for anyone to hide.
titles.video_title: A Sun (Mandarin with Chinese Subtitles 1080P)

titles.video_title: Marriage Story (2019)

Upon his release, his younger brother Tse-kit is now a police officer, and his old comrade Mark is crippled, shining shoes on the street. titles.video_title: So Long, My Son (2019)

By day, she cares for the children and cleans up after the dog; by night, she goes to the movies with her friend. The patriarch prepares to leave, and Cleo herself becomes pregnant by a man unwilling to take responsibility, as the sounds of a turbulent era begin to echo from the streets.
titles.video_title: Roma (2018)

A fire, a box of censored kissing scenes, and thirty years of absence later, Toto returns as a successful filmmaker to find the old cinema slated for demolition. Alfredo's final gift to him is still hidden within the film reels.
titles.video_title: Cinema Paradiso

One day, she discovers a hidden tin box in her apartment wall. After anonymously returning the toys to their owner from fifty years ago, she experiences a profound joy, leading her to secretly orchestrate small acts of kindness and surprises for the lonely people around her.

She uses her body and a false identity to get close to Mr. Yee, a Japanese collaborator. As the mission drags on, she struggles to distinguish whether she is an actress, a lover, or someone who has crossed a point of no return.

He struggles to survive on the streets with his sister, works odd jobs, and cares for his one-year-old brother. Though still a child himself, he has already shouldered the responsibility of a family. In court, all he asks is for them to stop having more children.

Forensic pathologist Mikoto Misumi, along with recorder Rokuro Kubota and sharp-tongued senior colleague Yuji Nakado, searches for clues from silent corpses. FBI Agent Cooper arrives with his tape recorder and an eccentric optimism, checking into a local hotel. Morning readings, motivational chants, parent-teacher conferences, and late-night heart-to-hearts unfold. The camera intimately captures this quintessential Chinese county-level examination, revealing how youth is relentlessly measured by scores.

Every year during Chunyun, they endure days and nights on crowded trains to return for Chinese New Year, but their reunions often end in arguments. The film captures the widening rift between the two generations.

Behind the food lies stories of migration, reunion, and the festive spirit and nostalgia passed down through generations.

titles.video_title: Hana-bi (Takeshi Kitano)

titles.title_zh: 能召回前世的布米叔叔
titles.title_en: Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives
titles.synopsis: Uncle Boonmee, suffering from kidney disease, returns to his rural farm to spend his final days. The ghost of his deceased wife and his son, who has transformed into a red-eyed ape, appear at the dinner table. In the Thai jungle, past, present, and future quietly converge over a single meal.
titles.video_title: Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives (2010)

titles.synopsis: In 1985, two British climbers descending Siula Grande in Peru faced disaster when one fell into a crevasse, breaking his leg. His partner, caught in a blizzard, was forced to cut the rope. The abandoned climber, with a broken leg, crawled across the ice for three days.
titles.video_title: Touching the Void

titles.synopsis: A twelve-year-old Greek girl and her five-year-old brother deceive their mother, claiming they're going to Germany to find their father. They board a train and head north, traversing snowy landscapes, trucks, and soldiers, searching for a father who may not even exist, as their childhood is slowly consumed by the mist.
titles.video_title: Landscape in the Mist

titles.synopsis: Music fans in Cape Town, South Africa, believed American singer Rodriguez had committed suicide. Two record collectors embark on a journey to investigate, only to discover that his albums sold hundreds of thousands of copies in South Africa, and that he is, in fact, alive and quietly working as a laborer in Detroit.
titles.video_title: Searching for Sugar Man

titles.synopsis: A small town in the American Rockies takes in Grace, a young woman on the run. The townspeople are initially friendly, but gradually exact a price through labor, surveillance, and desire. On the theatrical, wall-less set, the walls of human nature grow ever higher.
titles.video_title: Dogville

titles.synopsis: In a Tokyo apartment, four unregistered children are abandoned by their mother. Akira, the eldest brother, learns to buy groceries, manage finances, and care for his younger siblings. As utilities are cut off and money runs out, the children are slowly forgotten by the city over a long summer.
titles.video_title: Nobody Knows (2004) | Hirokazu Kore-eda, Douban 9.1 Highly-Rated Drama, Based on the True Sugamo Child Abandonment Case in Japan

titles.synopsis: Yu Xiuhua, a cerebral palsy poet from Hengdian Village in Hubei, rises to fame with a single poem. The film follows her as she navigates life, writing poetry, appearing on TV, and pursuing a divorce. The freedom brought by fame clashes with the constraints of marriage, as all she truly desires is a life she can truly call her own.
titles.video_title: Still Tomorrow | Yu Xiuhua Documentary

titles.title_en: The Internet's Own Boy: The Story of Aaron Swartz
titles.synopsis: At fourteen, Aaron Swartz helped develop the RSS standard, later co-founding Reddit and championing open access, only to be prosecuted by federal prosecutors for downloading academic papers. The film follows this prodigy through a lengthy trial concerning copyright, freedom, and power.
titles.video_title: The Internet's Own Boy: The Story of Aaron Swartz. BD Chinese/English Subtitles

titles.synopsis: In Fenyang county, petty thief Xiao Wu is shunned by his friends during a police crackdown, as his former associates transform into entrepreneurs. He continues to drift through the streets. When he tries to salvage a friendship and a romance, the changing times have already pushed people like him to the margins.
titles.video_title: Xiao Wu Full Movie | Wang Hongwei | Viewer Discretion Advised

titles.synopsis: In a Chicago flea market, a box of forgotten negatives is discovered to contain some of the 20th century's most captivating street photography. The artist, however, was an enigmatic nanny who worked for decades. The collector embarks on a quest to understand why she never revealed her work, finding that the life behind the photographs is even more mysterious than the images themselves.
titles.video_title: Finding Vivian Maier_BD Chinese/English Subtitles

titles.synopsis: Canyons, seas of clouds, cities, and flowing water accelerate, rewind, and repeat to Philip Glass's electronic score. With no narration, the film uses only visuals and rhythm to confront the audience with a prophecy of humanity's increasingly imbalanced civilization.
titles.video_title: Koyaanisqatsi (1982)

titles.title_en: Pastoral: To Die in the Country
titles.synopsis: A director returns to his hometown of Aomori to make a film about his childhood, where his mother, villagers, and ghosts from the past appear in turn. With layers of meta-narrative and theatrical staging, Shuji Terayama transforms homesickness into a vivid nightmare.
titles.video_title: Pastoral: To Die in the Country (1974) / Shuji Terayama

titles.synopsis: In an apartment in an industrial wasteland, the disheveled Henry marries his girlfriend, only to face a constantly wailing, deformed infant. Printers, radiators, whispers, and dreams transform the room into a nightmare, as Lynch uses black-and-white imagery to construct a mental asylum.
titles.video_title: Eraserhead

titles.synopsis: In 1889, Nietzsche embraced a whipped old horse on the streets of Turin, subsequently suffering a mental breakdown. The camera then turns to the horse and its owners—a father and daughter who repeat their daily routine of fetching water, boiling potatoes, and gazing out the window in a wind-swept farmhouse, until darkness descends.
titles.video_title: The Turin Horse (2011)

titles.synopsis: A police officer is shot dead on a Texas highway, and a death row inmate is found guilty, with the case seemingly airtight. Through stylized reenactments and layered interviews, the director uncovers flaws in testimonies and police investigations, reopening a murder case that had been considered closed.
titles.video_title: The Thin Blue Line (1988)

titles.synopsis: On the demolition sites of Fengjie, coal miner Han Sanming searches for his wife whom he hasn't seen in sixteen years, while nurse Shen Hong looks for her husband who hasn't returned home in two years. These two searches weave through ruins and river waters, as the Three Gorges Dam project submerges a town and many marriages along with it.
titles.video_title: Still Life (2006)

titles.synopsis: In Dushan, Guizhou, a retired teacher father plays the violin, his mother sings folk songs, and their children return home every Chinese New Year. Filmed over four springs, this documentary observes how this ordinary family transforms their mundane lives into poetry amidst reunions and partings, illness and death.
titles.video_title: Four Springs (2019)

titles.synopsis: Timothy Treadwell lived in an Alaskan grizzly bear sanctuary for thirteen consecutive years, naming bears, talking to them, and filming thousands of hours of footage. He claimed to be a protector of bears, yet he gradually crossed the line that should separate humans from wild beasts.
titles.video_title: Grizzly Man (2005)

titles.synopsis: In Chile's Atacama Desert, astronomers gaze upwards searching for the origins of the universe, while women look down, sifting through the sand for the remains of loved ones who disappeared during the dictatorship. Two gazes meet in the same desert; memory, like starlight, can never truly be buried.
titles.video_title: Nostalgia for the Light (2010)

titles.synopsis: A team infiltrates Taiji, Japan, with disguised cameras and underwater recording equipment to document the town's annual dolphin slaughter. Evading police and fishermen, they aim to turn a deliberately concealed industry into irrefutable evidence.
titles.video_title: The Cove (2009)

titles.synopsis: On the anniversary of their eldest son's death, the Yokoyama family's second son returns home with his remarried wife and child. As the mother fries corn and the father sulks, old grievances surface in the kitchen and on the way to the cemetery. A day of ordinary family life reveals decades of unspoken regrets.
titles.video_title: Still Walking (2008) | Hirokazu Kore-eda

titles.synopsis: In a seaside town, a deaf-mute young man named Shigeru falls in love with surfing, while his girlfriend Takako waits for him on the beach every day. With no dialogue, only the sound of waves, silence, and repeated falls and recoveries, summer passes, and life, along with the sea, quietly changes.
titles.video_title: A Scene at the Sea (1991) [Original Audio with Chinese Subtitles]

titles.synopsis: Crusader Knight Antonius Block returns from battle to a Europe ravaged by the Black Death. On the seashore, he plays a game of chess with Death, using the delay to question faith, death, and the meaning of life, encountering circus performers, penitents, and a procession of the doomed along the way.
titles.video_title: The Seventh Seal (1957) [Chinese Subtitles] Bergman

titles.synopsis: In Aichi Prefecture, Japan, an elderly couple cultivates seventy kinds of vegetables and fifty fruit trees in their garden. The ninety-year-old husband and eighty-seven-year-old wife spend their days weeding, writing letters, and picking fruit. The camera quietly observes them living their lives through the slow rhythm of the four seasons.
titles.video_title: Documentary: Life Is Fruity

titles.synopsis: After the death of choreographer Pina Bausch, the dancers of the Tanztheater Wuppertal recreate her works on stage. Wim Wenders places the dancers in cities, on grass, and inside glass boxes, allowing their bodies to express the words she never had the chance to say.
titles.video_title: Pina Bausch: Iphigenia in Tauris

titles.synopsis: In the summer of 1969, 400,000 young people flocked to a farm outside New York State for three days and nights of music, mud, and love. The film captures the roaring guitars on stage and the barefoot crowds below, who temporarily created a utopia before watching it dissolve.
titles.video_title: Rock Extravaganza: Woodstock Music Festival 1969 (Blu-ray Edition)

titles.synopsis: Amin, an Afghan refugee, is about to marry his Danish boyfriend but has never dared to reveal how he fled alone to Northern Europe. Animation interwoven with interviews gradually uncovers the fear of illegal migration, the separation of family, and the concealment of his homosexual identity.
titles.video_title: Animated Film 'Flee' is Richly Layered and Unflinching. Its Refugee Theme is Heart-Wrenching. Blurring Genre Boundaries, it Offers a Fresh Experience. Nominated for Oscars, Sweeping Awards. Directed by Jonas Poher Rasmussen, Douban 8.1.

titles.synopsis: The camera dives from the surface to the sunless depths of the ocean, capturing sardine storms, jellyfish ballets, and whale shark patrols. Jacques Perrin spent four years exploring the oceans, bringing the blue territory that covers three-quarters of the Earth to the audience's eyes.
titles.video_title: A French Ocean Documentary Five Years in the Making ✿ Top-tier Sound Recording Technology ✨ Will Blow Your Ears Away

titles.synopsis: In a dilapidated mansion in East Hampton, New York, a mother and daughter live in isolation, their rooms filled with trash, stray cats, and old memories. The Maysles brothers use direct cinema to intimately film them, turning their dependent and entangled relationship into an absurd drama.
titles.video_title: Documentary: Grey Gardens (1975) Bilingual Subtitles

titles.synopsis: Two Black teenagers from Chicago are scouted and enter a private high school to pursue their NBA dreams. Over five years of filming, injuries, tuition fees, family issues, and academic pressure constantly arise. Behind the basketball dream lies the only narrow path for the American urban underclass to climb upwards.
titles.video_title: Sports/Documentary/Chinese Subtitles: Hoop Dreams 1994 [Behind the Few Stars, Countless Others Fell by the Wayside] [TSPDT NO.487]

titles.synopsis: On the banks of Shanghai's Suzhou River, deliveryman Ma Da falls in love with bar owner Mu Dan, and later plays a devoted lover in another mermaid story. A photographer narrates the love he observes by the river, where truth and falsehood shimmer like light on the water.
titles.video_title: 【4K Blu-ray Remaster】Suzhou River .Lou Ye .2000 .Suzhou River .

titles.synopsis: Petty criminal Michel steals cars, robs people, and evades police on the streets of Paris, falling for Patricia, an American newspaper seller. In their apartment, they chat, smoke, and test each other. Jump cuts and handheld shots capture a fleeting, urgent love story with no tomorrow.
titles.video_title: 【1080p】Breathless (Film Classic)

titles.synopsis: Before losing his sight, Derek Jarman turns the camera to a pure blue screen. The soundtrack and voiceover recount hospital rooms, treatments, a lover's hand, and his fading vision. When the world becomes only blue, he uses sound to calmly narrate the final days of his life to the audience.
titles.video_title: Blue.Blue.Derek Jarman.Derek Jarman.1993

titles.synopsis: The camera follows flocks of geese, storks, and swans across over forty countries, from the Arctic to the Sahara. With no narration, only the sound of wings, wind, and the changing seasons, viewers are transported into the long journey of migration as if they were birds themselves.
titles.video_title: 【Documentary】Winged Migration 2001【Chinese and English Subtitles】

titles.synopsis: Russian poet Andrei travels to Italy to write a biography of an 18th-century composer, but becomes consumed by the prophecies of a mad old man and dreams of his homeland. Wandering between a spa town and Rome, he ultimately decides to fulfill a mad promise for the man everyone mocks.
titles.video_title: 【4K SDR Hi-Res】Nostalghia Ностальгия

titles.synopsis: Exhausted after completing a film, director Guido retreats to a sanatorium to conceive his next project, only to be entangled by his wife, mistress, and childhood memories. Dreams, recollections, and film sets intertwine in black and white, leading him to realize that the very creative crisis he's experiencing is the film he needs to make.
titles.video_title: [Mandarin 4K] 8½ (1963)

titles.synopsis: Twenty-two elderly women, former comfort women for the Japanese army, live scattered across rural Guangxi, Shanxi, and Hainan. The camera simply observes them eating, sunbathing, staring blankly, and remaining silent. As these historical witnesses age and pass, their quiet daily lives become the most profound testimony.
titles.video_title: Twenty Two (2017)

titles.synopsis: The leaders of two major powers play cards at a conference table, and with each turn of the game, pilots on the front lines hunt each other down. Two unlucky pilots battle from the sky to a desert island, transforming from enemies to comrades, only to discover that the world-altering war above them is merely a game of poker in someone else's hands.
titles.video_title: [4K60FPS Hi-Res] Jiaozi's Debut Film 'See Through' Top Restoration!!!

titles.synopsis: Aboard a small boat on a nighttime sea voyage, a father and grandfather demonstrate their family's inherited craft to a young boy: waiting for the moon to rise, setting up a long ladder to climb onto its surface, and sweeping up fallen stars. When the two generations are at odds, a giant star crashes down, forcing the boy to decide what to do on his own.
titles.video_title: [Healing] Oscar's 84th Academy Awards Short Film 'La Luna', a heartwarming seven-minute animation

titles.synopsis: On the beach, a young sandpiper learns to forage with its mother for the first time, but is disoriented by a sudden wave and retreats to its nest, waiting to be fed. When its mother sternly stops feeding it, the chick must brave the waves again, discovering a new world among the foam, shells, and underwater.
titles.video_title: Oscar Best Animated Short Film 'Piper'

titles.synopsis: A father discovers his son can float, hovering like a balloon near the ceiling. Fearing judgment, he ties him down with ropes, weighs him with stones, and keeps the curtains drawn. But when the boy floats towards the sky in a park, the father must make a choice.
titles.video_title: Pixar Animated Short 'Float': Every Special Person Deserves Love

titles.synopsis: A group of colorful bean-like characters take turns dying in the most absurd ways: poking a toaster with a fork, licking high-voltage wires, keeping a bear as a pet. Accompanied by an unusually cheerful children's song, this advertisement turned safety warnings into a catchy, globally hummable tune.
titles.video_title: YouTube's 200 Million Views Animated Short 'Dumb Ways to Die'

titles.synopsis: In a world where everyone is a wine glass, each glass must undergo a rite of passage: being filled with strong liquor and then emptied. Number 585 is a timid glass, watching its companions being filled one by one. It tries to escape but finds there's nowhere to go.
titles.video_title: Oscar-Nominated High-Rated Metaphorical Animation 'Pour 585'

titles.synopsis: A boy lives in a valley inhabited by white birds. One day, he discovers a mysterious large bird hunting the white birds and tracks its movements. Through clouds, bamboo forests, and ancient statues, he encounters something far more complex than a simple predator-prey relationship.
titles.video_title: Stunning 'Animation Oscars' Domestic Animated Short 'Valley of White Birds' Full Version Released for the First Time!

titles.synopsis: A stray puppy is won over by a passing man with a single french fry, beginning a life of meaty meals. It accompanies its owner through falling in love, breaking up, and finding love again, ultimately helping him preserve what truly matters amidst plates of food and pairs of chopsticks.
titles.video_title: [Animation/Romance] 'Feast' Delicious Feast - 2014 - 87th Academy Award for Best Animated Short Film (Full Version)

titles.synopsis: In the sky, clouds sculpt babies to be delivered by storks. While other clouds create adorable kittens and puppies, Gus, a gloomy cloud, specializes in crafting crocodiles, goats, and porcupines. His stork partner always returns battered and bruised. This time, Gus presents him with a baby shark.
titles.video_title: Creative Animated Short Film 'Partly Cloudy', Full of Warmth!

titles.synopsis: A man attempting suicide in his bathtub receives an unexpected call from his estranged sister, pleading with him to look after her young daughter for a few hours. As he spends an absurd yet heartwarming night with his niece, his seemingly dead-end life begins to subtly transform.
titles.video_title: Oscar-Winning Short Film 'Curfew'

titles.synopsis: A man wakes up, washes, and goes to work in a city where people serve as objects: a person hunches over to be a desk lamp, another kneels to form a chair, and mirrors, elevators, and traffic lights are all living individuals. He impassively navigates this city that turns people into furniture, until he too takes his place in an unseen cubicle.
titles.video_title: El Empleo / The Employment [1080P]

titles.synopsis: In a monochromatic city, a working father and his school-aged son are drained of their vibrancy by daily reports, homework, and rigid rules. When the father discovers his son has colored a test paper into a rainbow, he remembers his own past love for drawing. He then decides to help his child reclaim the colors that rules had taken away.
titles.video_title: Alike: Oscar-Winning Best Animated Short Film

titles.synopsis: A woman prepares for bed, only to discover a sinister figure emerging from the shadows every time she turns off the hallway light. As she repeatedly flips the switch, the shadow rapidly closes in on her bedroom.
titles.video_title: Warning: Intense! Award-Winning Horror Short Film: 'Lights Out'

titles.title_en: The Fantastic Flying Books of Mr. Morris Lessmore
titles.synopsis: A book-loving man named Morris and his house are swept away by a hurricane. He wakes up to a world drained of color. Following a flying book, he enters a library, reading stories to puppets and writing his own life, page by page, until his gray world regains its vibrant hues.
titles.video_title: Oscar-Winning Best Animated Short Film: The Fantastic Flying Books of Mr. Morris Lessmore

titles.synopsis: On a suburban road, Bus 44 is stopped by two thugs. The female driver is held hostage, and no passenger speaks up, except for one frail young man who rushes out to help but gets injured. The driver takes the wheel again, first forcing the young man off the bus, then closing the doors.
titles.video_title: Bus 44 (2001) - Female-centric art short film by Hong Kong director Wu Shixian, Venice Film Festival award-winner. A humanities art short film, a must-see low-budget example for directors and screenwriters.

titles.synopsis: A black cat narrates his life with his owner: she wakes early, goes to work, worn down by life, and collapses into sleep upon returning home. He, meanwhile, watches the seasons change and the city rain from the window. He believes he fell in love with the world before she did.
titles.video_title: Makoto Shinkai - She and Her Cat

titles.synopsis: In the desolate Australian Outback, a small creature with rabbit-like ears and a bandicoot-like nose struggles to survive amidst predators. It rescues a lost hatchling, and to return the fluffy little one to its nest, it must navigate through snakes, lizards, scorpions, and cliffs.
titles.video_title: Bilby (2018) - Oscar-Winning Best Animated Short Film

titles.synopsis: A girl discovers a series of animations online where the characters' faces and bodies are identical to her private selfies. She tracks down the uploader, finding a woman with the same name who admits to stealing her image but dies before she can explain, leaving only a video behind.
titles.video_title: Why Did You Draw Me? A Kind of Testament (2024 Oscar-Nominated Animated Short Film)

titles.synopsis: A socially anxious rabbit just wants to dig a burrow all to itself, hoping no one will visit. But with one scoop of its shovel, it finds a mole brewing tea next door and a badger playing the trumpet upstairs. The interconnected neighborhood map completely ruins its plan for solitary living.
titles.video_title: Pixar's New Animated Short 'Burrow' Full Film

titles.synopsis: Ally, a mother of three, feels drained by household chores. Through her window, she observes the lives of the young couple across the street: parties, intimacy, arguments, and carefree living. She becomes increasingly addicted to watching, until one day she realizes that window is also looking back at her.
tags: Oscar Winner Best Live Action Short
titles.video_title: Oscar Winner Best Live Action Short 'The Neighbors' Window'

titles.synopsis: Young Peter lives with his grandfather in a forest cabin surrounded by high walls. Outside, there's a frozen lake and hungry wolves. After a wolf snatches Peter's goose, he sets a trap with a bird and a cat, capturing the wolf alive. But at the market, facing the caged beast, he has a change of heart.
titles.video_title: [Art Short Film] Prokofiev's 'Peter & the Wolf' with Daniele Gatti and the Orchestre National de France Pierre et le loup Orchestre National de France

titles.synopsis: After failing at the Bernstein Competition, pianist Adrien puts on contact lenses and pretends to be a blind piano tuner, earning tips through sympathy and peeking into others' lives. One day, he knocks on a door, finds a body on the carpet inside, and the door quietly closes behind him.
titles.video_title: Oscar-Winning Short Film 'The Piano Tuner' French Version 4K Restored

titles.synopsis: A lonely mother makes a dumpling, which miraculously comes to life and becomes her cherished child. She feeds it, protects it, and shields it from the world. But children eventually grow up, go out, fall in love, and move away, leaving the mother to turn her reluctance into a single bite.
titles.video_title: Bao - Pixar Heartwarming Animated Short

titles.synopsis: Black cartoonist Carter wakes up on a New York street, wanting only to go home and walk his dog, but is repeatedly stopped, pinned down, and shot by the same police officer. He keeps returning to the same bed, reliving the morning with memories of his previous deaths, trying to survive it differently each time.
titles.video_title: Oscar-Winning Live Action Short Film 'Two Distant Strangers'

titles.synopsis: Two middle school friends who promised to watch the stars together are separated when the girl is chosen to be a space fleet pilot, leaving one on Earth and the other in deep space. Text messages take years, even decades, to reach each other's phones, as the boy grows up waiting for increasingly delayed replies.
titles.video_title: Makoto Shinkai's 'Voices of a Distant Star'

titles.synopsis: An Iranian girl spreads her old school uniform on a table, recounting her memories of growing up between school rules and the hijab, starting from the fabric's creases, fading, and stitches. The disciplines wrapped within the cloth gradually weave into her understanding of herself as a woman.
titles.video_title: Focusing on Women's Liberation, 2024 Oscar-Nominated Iranian Animation 'Our Uniform'

titles.synopsis: On Chinese New Year's Eve, a mother in a small Changzhou town emerges from the police station; her daughter hasn't returned home from school. She makes calls and knocks on classmates' doors, searching through alleys amidst fireworks and mahjong sounds. Dawn is approaching, and she is still looking.
titles.video_title: Cannes Award-Winning Short Film 'A Gentle Night' (Self-Translated Subtitles)

titles.synopsis: Everyone in the city is looking down at their phones: doctors operate on patients while staring at screens, firefighters scroll through videos as they exit burning buildings, and couples on dates each look at their own screens. As everyone buries their heads in the small light in their palms, the entire city begins to collapse in an absurd manner.
titles.video_title: Award-Winning Chinese Short Film 'Life Smartphone', Reflecting Social Phenomena!

titles.synopsis: Two characters with contrasting personalities meet: one embodies sunshine, beaches, and birdsong, while the other holds neon lights, starry skies, and late-night dog barks. Each finds the other strange. They compete and peek into each other's worlds until they discover that from a different perspective, day and night can form a single, unified picture.
titles.video_title: Day & Night - Pixar's 2010 Creative Animated Short

titles.synopsis: A robin's egg rolls into a mouse's nest, and Robin is raised by a family of mice, but she can't seem to learn how to steal. To prove herself, she sneaks into a human house, where she meets a magpie who wants to be a mouse, and for the first time, truly understands who she is.
titles.video_title: Robin Robin (2021) - Oscar Short Film

titles.synopsis: A timid boy on the cusp of adolescence is dragged by his best friend to the most popular and terrifying water slide at the water park. Inside the pitch-black tube, as he plunges down, he sees glimpses of his own future—visions that make him want to escape, yet compel him to look again.
titles.video_title: Black Slide (2021) - Oscar Best Animated Short Nominee

titles.synopsis: On a bustling farm, four-year-old deaf child Libby lives in silence, often treated as if she cannot speak. Social worker Joanne arrives to teach her sign language, and the two build a quiet world together, while Libby's parents wish their daughter could be just like everyone else.
titles.video_title: The Silent Child (2017) - Oscar Best Live Action Short

titles.synopsis: A psychiatrist is invited to a prison to evaluate Voorman, a high-security inmate who claims to be an omnipotent God. Faced with Voorman's incredible proofs of divine power, the doctor, a staunch believer in science and reason, finds himself in an inescapable cognitive crisis.
titles.video_title: The Voorman Problem (2011) - 720p

titles.synopsis: On a farm in Northern Ireland, after their mother's sudden death, estranged brother Turlough returns home to find his younger brother Lorcan, who has Down syndrome, maintaining the farm alone. Lorcan presents a bucket list their mother left unfinished, insisting they complete it before he'll leave.
tags: Oscar Winner Best Live Action Short
titles.video_title: An Irish Goodbye / Oscar Nominee Best Live Action Short (2022)

titles.synopsis: At a supermarket checkout, a white man clashes with a Black man who smiled at his child, leading to a violent assault in the parking lot. This confrontation sparks a chain of retaliatory actions, culminating in a cruel fate for both families.
titles.video_title: The 91st Academy Awards Best Live Action Short: Skin

titles.synopsis: On a stormy night, a lost traveler takes shelter in a shrine filled with discarded items. Broken umbrellas, old dolls, and waste paper transform into Yokai, demanding his life. He decides to sit down and meticulously repair each discarded object. By dawn, the Yokai's demeanor has changed.
titles.video_title: Possessions (2014 Japanese Animated Film)

titles.title_en: The Boy, the Mole, the Fox and the Horse
titles.synopsis: Lost in the snow, a boy meets a cake-loving mole, then a silent fox, and finally a white horse. These four lonely souls journey together through the blizzard, constantly questioning the meaning of kindness, courage, and love on their search for home, slowly realizing that home isn't necessarily just a place.
titles.video_title: The 95th Academy Awards Best Animated Short: The Boy, the Mole, the Fox and the Horse

titles.synopsis: Greenwood, a typographer in London, has a severe stutter. For six years, he's only communicated with a girl he met online. When she finally comes to London to meet him, he spends an entire night rehearsing lines, practicing every word, only to discover at a park bench that perhaps perfect speech isn't necessary at all.
tags: Oscar Winner Best Live Action Short
titles.video_title: 2016 Oscar Winner Best Live Action Short: Stutterer

titles.synopsis: Every day, the little dam keeper turns a giant windmill to keep the ominous black fog away from the town. Yet, the town's children, repulsed by his smell, take turns bullying him. A new fox classmate arrives with colorful pencils, bringing not only friendship but also a secret about human nature darker than the black fog itself.
titles.video_title: Touching Animated Short Film 'The Dam Keeper' - Nominated for Best Animated Short Film at the 87th Academy Awards

titles.synopsis: An old guqin master falls ill at a ferry crossing and is rescued by a young fisherman, who takes him home to recover. They form a master-apprentice bond, with the old man teaching the boy to play the guqin amidst the mountains and rivers. Once the boy's skills mature, the old man leaves his guqin with him and walks alone into the deep mist, never looking back.
titles.video_title: Classic Guqin Ink Wash Animation 'Feelings of Mountains and Waters'

titles.title_en: The Wonderful Story of Henry Sugar
titles.synopsis: A wealthy playboy accidentally reads a mysterious medical report detailing an Indian guru's ability to see through objects without using his eyes. To win vast sums in gambling, he secludes himself to master this extraordinary skill. However, upon truly acquiring the divine ability, he undergoes a profound spiritual transformation.
titles.video_title: 'The Wonderful Story of Henry Sugar' (2023), Directed by Wes Anderson, Oscar Winner for Best Live Action Short Film, Arthouse Auteur Film, OCD-Friendly

titles.synopsis: In a tranquil English village, a church, a pub, and a graveyard form a circle, as villagers peer at each other from behind windows. The arrival of an outsider woman is like a stone cast into still water, bringing forth gossip, jealousy, and hypocrisy. Everyone clings tightly to their own secrets.
titles.video_title: Human Nature Reflection Animation 'The Village'

titles.title_en: In the Shadow of the Cypress

The demo highlights the infinite potential of air-tap gestures, voice interaction, and digital holographic projection in engineering collaboration and home entertainment.
titles.video_title: ACS309 Microsoft HoloLens   Transform your world with holograms

titles.title_zh: Tesla Optimus第二代人形机器人功能演示
titles.synopsis: In an R&D lab, the second-generation humanoid robot autonomously performs gait balance fine-tuning, joint range-of-motion extensions, and pressure sensor tests. The demo showcases the robot's astonishing haptic feedback as it delicately picks up a raw egg with its mechanical fingertips and precisely transfers it to an egg steamer rack, demonstrating the synergy of AI and precision mechanics.
titles.video_title: Optimus - Gen 2 | Tesla

titles.title_zh: DJI Ronin 4D四轴电影摄影机装配教学
titles.synopsis: A film equipment engineer provides a comprehensive explanation of the rapid assembly and parameter tuning for an integrated 4-axis stabilized camera system. The tutorial covers balancing, wireless video transmission and control pairing, and laser autofocus radar calibration, aiming to guide professional solo cinematographers through an efficient out-of-the-box workflow.
titles.video_title: How to Balance & Control DJI Ronin 4D Properly | Complete Setup Guide for Smooth Footage

titles.title_zh: Leica M10旁轴相机结构与操作演示
titles.synopsis: An optical engineer meticulously explains the minimalist operational logic of a classic rangefinder digital camera at a workbench. From a demonstration of the principle behind the split-image manual focusing mechanism to the tactile mechanical dampening of the new physical ISO dial, the presentation fully showcases the allure of purely mechanical adjustments to photography enthusiasts.
titles.video_title: Leica M10P - Quick Look Hands-on

titles.synopsis: In the majestic high mountains of Azerbaijan, a chef lights a primitive charcoal fire to prepare a whole fresh lamb weighing tens of kilograms. Battling harsh outdoor conditions and the challenge of slow roasting, he bastes the meat with a secret sauce amidst howling mountain winds, achieving a golden, crispy crust.
titles.video_title: Cooking Whole Lamb in the Mountains | Epic Outdoor Dinner Experience

titles.title_zh: 传统坛子辣白菜泡菜制作
titles.synopsis: In early winter, a blogger purchases dozens of plump napa cabbages and personally demonstrates the complete process of making kimchi, from coarse salting to preparing the spicy glutinous rice paste. Despite the physically demanding task, she meticulously rubs the vibrant red sauce into each cabbage leaf before sealing them in earthenware jars.
titles.video_title: Traditional kimchi recipe (Tongbaechu-kimchi: 통배추김치)

titles.title_zh: 极简冷萃咖啡制作指南
titles.synopsis: In his messy apartment kitchen, a quirky, solitary protagonist embarks on a homemade cold brew coffee experiment, silently battling flying coffee grounds and clumsy filter paper. Through a series of unconventional steps and deadpan monologues, a bottle of chilled coffee slowly takes shape.
titles.video_title: How to: Three Ways to Cold Brew Coffee

titles.synopsis: In the early summer mountains, the protagonist harvests fresh green plums, undertaking the intricate manual processes of washing, destemming, and preserving them with rock sugar. As the seasons change in a rustic countryside home, a pot of sweet, sour, and mellow brew patiently awaits time to develop its unique flavor.
titles.video_title: Make Chinese Fruit Sake for 1st time! | Leechee & Green Plum wine

titles.synopsis: As the Lunar New Year approaches in a village in western Yunnan, the hostess and her neighbors collaborate to prepare the year's most elaborate pork feast. Amidst the intricate tasks of deboning fresh meat and marinating with traditional spices, hosts and guests gather, preparing a reunion banquet as cooking smoke rises.
titles.video_title: A Rich Traditional Pork Feast | The Most Indulgent Stuffed Pork Belly

titles.title_zh: 宇治抹茶戚风蛋糕制作
titles.synopsis: A dessert creator meticulously bakes a matcha chiffon cake in a serene wooden kitchen. With no dialogue, the film focuses on the precise techniques of sifting flour and whipping egg whites. Close-up shots highlight the delicate blend of batter and tea aroma, offering viewers a calming and immersive culinary journey.
titles.video_title: The Softest Matcha Chiffon Cake – Light, Airy & Full of Green Tea Flavor

titles.title_zh: 给猫咪特制的三文鱼寿司
titles.synopsis: Under the curious gaze of their beloved cat, a chef meticulously prepares a gourmet salmon sushi meal, adhering strictly to pet health standards. From precise slicing to artful hand-shaping, this culinary creator crafts an exquisite, high-end Japanese dish specifically for their discerning feline companion.
titles.video_title: Sushi For Cats - Cats Try Sushi For The First Time - Instinct Raw Cat Food Vs Homemade Cat Sushi

titles.synopsis: A master chef tackles the seemingly simple task of making scrambled eggs, demonstrating how precise temperature control and off-heat timing create a perfectly silky texture. Through rapid stirring and the melting of butter, the chef breaks down the essential techniques for elevating this everyday breakfast staple.
titles.video_title: How To Make Perfect Scrambled Eggs - 3 ways | Jamie Oliver

titles.title_zh: 曼谷街头寻访冬阴功之魂
titles.synopsis: A culinary traveler braves the scorching heat of Bangkok's bustling traditional markets, seeking out hidden, old-school Tom Yum establishments. Confronted by the intense and complex flavors of tropical spices, he offers a first-person perspective, immersing viewers in the vibrant 'wok hei' (breath of the wok) of authentic street food stalls.
titles.video_title: I Tried 5 Tom Yum Noodles in Bangkok 🇹🇭—Which One Is Truly the Best?

titles.title_zh: 挑战变态辣鸡翅：戈登·拉姆齐特辑
titles.synopsis: A world-renowned chef guests on a talk show, where he must answer challenging questions while progressively consuming ten intensely spicy 'devil wings.' As the capsaicin levels skyrocket, the usually stern and composed chef gradually loses his composure, pushing his physiological limits in a hilarious and wild display.
titles.video_title: Gordon Ramsay Savagely Critiques Spicy Wings | Hot Ones

titles.title_zh: 街头美食寻味台北胡椒饼
titles.synopsis: A food enthusiast navigates the charcoal-fired workshops deep within a night market, seeking out artisans of a time-honored tradition: baking pepper buns in iron barrel ovens. Facing the intense heat and the fast-paced rhythm of production, he meticulously documents the essence of this traditional craft, from its crispy exterior to its juicy filling.
titles.video_title: Raohe Night Market in Taipei: MUST-EAT Taiwan Street Food - Pepper Pork Buns & Bone Soup!

titles.title_zh: 复刻半个世纪前的复古明胶沙拉
titles.synopsis: A blogger delves into vintage mid-20th century cookbooks, attempting to recreate a nostalgic salad that bizarrely combines vegetables, meat, and sweet gelatin. Amidst the tedious waiting for setting and the risk of collapse upon unmolding, the blogger confronts the unknown challenges posed by this peculiar flavor combination.
titles.video_title: How To Make 1950s Jell-O Salad

titles.title_zh: 大厨与厨艺小白的威灵顿牛排对决
titles.synopsis: Three amateur home cooks challenge a professional chef to each prepare a high-difficulty Beef Wellington within a tense time limit. Facing the dual threats of soggy pastry and overcooked tenderloin, the contestants scramble, each employing their unique skills to overcome the culinary hurdles.
titles.video_title: BEEF WELLINGTON BUDGET BATTLE | Chef (£2.50) VS Normal (Unlimited Budget) | Sorted Food

titles.title_zh: 手工酿造一缸传统大豆酱油
titles.synopsis: Starting with soybean planting in early spring, the blogger meticulously follows the months-long process of growth and harvest, followed by steaming, fermentation, and sun-drying in sealed jars with mountain spring water. Enduring the long passage of time, exposure to the elements, and careful protection against spoilage, she finally presses the first batch of fragrant, purely handmade soy sauce in late autumn.
titles.video_title: Inside a Traditional Soy Sauce Brewery | You’ve Never Seen How Soy Sauce Is Made

titles.title_zh: 老友记中的感恩节三明治
titles.synopsis: A cooking blogger attempts to recreate the multi-layered turkey sandwich, cherished by the protagonist in a popular sitcom, within a modern kitchen. Facing the technical challenge of bread slices easily collapsing after soaking up gravy, the blogger meticulously replicates each layer to explore the true taste of this cinematic delicacy.
titles.video_title: The "Friends" Thanksgiving Leftovers Sandwich w/ The "Moist Maker"

titles.title_zh: 无烤箱制作浓郁生巧克力蛋糕
titles.synopsis: A host wearing a cat-ear headband, accompanied by a lazy pet cat, prepares a dessert using a cookie base and dark chocolate cream, all without an oven. During the setting process, the chef overcomes the risk of breakage during demolding to present a rich, mirror-smooth pastry.
titles.video_title: Chocolate Mousse Cake | Chocolate Dessert Recipe | NO Bake

titles.synopsis: As the sea level continuously rises, submerging the town, a lonely old man is forced to build his house upwards, block by block. While diving to retrieve his beloved pipe, he descends through layers of old submerged homes, gradually uncovering a lifetime of family memories.
titles.video_title: The 81st Academy Award for Best Animated Short Film: The House of Small Cubes (Tsumiki no Ie) 2008

titles.synopsis: An African-American little girl eagerly anticipates her sick mother's return home from the hospital, hoping to greet her with the most beautiful afro hairstyle. Her young father, with no prior hairstyling experience, is tasked with the mission, leading to a chaotic battle with hair rollers, flying clips, and styling tutorial videos.
titles.video_title: The 92nd Academy Award for Best Animated Short Film: Hair Love (2019)

titles.synopsis: In the lost and found box of a Japanese restaurant, a knitted dinosaur and a knitted fox fall in love. When the little fox accidentally falls into a reservoir and is on the brink of death, the knitted dinosaur selflessly unravels its own yarn to save its beloved, running desperately as it continuously dismantles itself.
titles.video_title: Animated Short Film: Lost and Found (2018)

titles.synopsis: The protagonist recalls his father, who often traveled for business. In his childhood, his father taught him the most valuable skill: how to perfectly pack a suitcase. Amidst the folding of clothes and the meticulous measurement of space at the bottom of the case, a restrained yet profound emotional connection between father and son quietly unfolds.
titles.video_title: Animated Short Film: Negative Space (2017)

titles.synopsis: In a desolate autumn park, a white-haired old man sits alone at a stone table, setting up a chessboard. To combat his loneliness, he repeatedly switches seats, engaging in a fierce chess match against himself – one with glasses, one without – employing cunning tactics to gain an advantage.
titles.video_title: Geri's Game - Pixar Classic Animated Short

titles.synopsis: An anonymous clay worker toils numbly on a dark, cold assembly line, exhausted by monotonous tasks. Secretly, he develops magical goggles at night that allow people to see brilliant colors. However, after his product becomes a worldwide sensation, he falls into an even deeper spiritual emptiness.
titles.video_title: Oscar-Winning Animated Short: More

titles.synopsis: A young traveler hikes through the dry, desolate highlands of Provence and encounters a taciturn old shepherd. This old man silently selects hundreds of plump acorns each day and plants them in the barren soil. Over decades of war and change, he single-handedly creates a vibrant, lush forest.
titles.video_title: Animated: The Man Who Planted Trees (1987)

titles.synopsis: A legendary basketball player, with a sincere voice, recites a farewell letter to basketball, reminiscing about his journey from childhood dreams of shooting his father's rolled-up socks as a ball to reaching the pinnacle of the world. Facing the reality of an aging body and lingering injuries, he solemnly bids a heartfelt farewell to the sport he loved his entire life.
titles.video_title: Oscar-Winning Short: Dear Basketball

titles.synopsis: Two octopus lovers, inseparable in their Greek seaside aquarium, are forced apart when one is bought by a restaurant owner. The other brave octopus resolutely leaps out of the water, onto a delivery truck, and embarks on a thrilling rescue escape through the town's winding staircases and narrow alleys.
titles.video_title: Funny Short Film | Oktapodi
